BL-1556 — bl1272LandedSiblingInvariants.property.test.js is red on main under load with no owner: invariant 1 spawns one bb process per fast-check draw (60 per run, 0.19 s each quiet) against a CLI whose header promises one process per property run, so the 20 s testTimeout holds only on a quiet host (29.2 s FAIL then 19.5 s pass, alone on main) - the draws are judged in one landed-batch query and the fixture's git steps fail loud instead of surfacing as an unexplained origin/main error
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the 20 s testTimeout in vitest.properties.config.mjs is not raised and no per-test timeout is added - BL-871 raised budgets for tests whose cost was real subprocess work, this cost is 5…
BL-1556 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1556" (or "reject BL-1556 <reason>") to act.
